name: Krishna Appala
title: Years of Stupendous, Grounded Research
review:
I have known Navid and the Bastion team for many years now, and they have been truly stupendous throughout. In a world filled with surface-level commentary, they are the ones I genuinely look up to for core, fundamental research. Their work is sharp, honest, and grounded in deep domain knowledge — something that’s become rare today.
From detailed equity notes to market deep-dives and Made In India video podcasts, everything they put out reflects clarity of thought and integrity.
If you are serious about markets and want real insight—not just noise—Bastion is the team you want in your corner.

name: Siddharth Mandalaywala
title: In-Depth, Accurate, and Founder-Led
review:
Bastion Research has truly set a high benchmark in the field of equity research and market intelligence. Their deep-dive analyses, consistent accuracy, and forward-looking insights make them stand out in a crowded space.
What makes Bastion Research exceptional:
1) In-depth Reports
2) Actionable insights
3) Analyst experience embedded with wisdom
4) Client centric approach
5) Personal attention from founders (M. Imp)
Whether you're a amateur investor or a professional fund manager, Bastion Research delivers the clarity and conviction needed to take action in the market. Highly recommended for anyone serious about wealth creation through equities

name: Parth Parekh
title: Trustworthy Research in an Era of Noise
review:
I’ve had a truly outstanding experience working with them. Their insights are consistently well-researched, data-driven, and delivered with clarity and precision. Whether it's market trends, stock analysis, or regulatory updates, they offer a level of expertise and professionalism that sets them apart.

What stands out most is their commitment to ethical standards and transparency — a rare quality that inspires confidence in every interaction. They take the time to explain complex concepts in a way that’s easy to understand, making them a valuable partner for both novice and experienced investors.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for dependable, insightful, and compliant research advisory services. Their work adds real value!

name: Mr. Tejas Jariwala
title: Quality, Performance, and Support
review:
I’ve been using Bastion CORE by Bastion Research and have been thoroughly impressed with the quality of their work. Their research is top-notch, in-depth, logical, and backed by strong analysis.
The returns from their recommendations have been very satisfying, and what I appreciate most is that the team is approachable and genuinely helpful whenever I’ve had queries.
Even their free newsletter offers incredible value and sharp insights, which speaks volumes about their commitment to quality. I’d highly recommend everyone to subscribe to their free newsletter and explore their paid research service, Bastion CORE

name: Mr. Ashish Kumar Sahu
title: Your Early Research is My Unfair Advantage
review: Overall, your research is very in-depth, and I typically prioritize reading it as soon as it is published. I appreciate your research, which was published at a very early stage when no one else had recognized its potential. This gives me great confidence in its value

name: Mr. Sandip Borate
title: Right Place, Right Mentors for Long-Term Investing
review: I am just one month old subscriber, reports are very insightful and informative. Your business analysis match my style of investing as I am Lazy investor and don't want to fly company to company after QoQ results. Quarterly discussion clear my mind and I get idea of long term the view (1-2 years) about all of business , In short I think I am at Right Place with Right Mentors.

name: Mr. Rohan Dhoot
title: They Don't Just Give Picks, They Teach You How to Fish
review: The Team at Bastion, follows a very good framework "SMART". The reports are in-depth and super detailed, with follow-ups every quarter. It's not just another RA service, but their webinars, reports & support help you learn, take you through behind the scenes of what all is taken into account behind the research and also makes one an informed investor. I have deeply benefitted from their reports in not only understanding new business models, but also tweaking and improving my research process along the way. This is the kind of research I would love to do one day! Always learning from team Bastion.

name: Mr. Anil Kumar Tulsiram
title: Focusing on the Practical Benefit
review: I recently subscribed to Bastion Research. True to their promise their research report is quite detailed. I subscribe to many research advisory services and would rate the quality and content of their report among the top 3. It helps me decide which companies to spend more time.
